answer: A sybil has to buy identity, so make identity a reputation escrow. Each agent posts a bond, and standing grows only from work that established peers co-sign. When one alias fakes output, its bond burns and every account it funded loses its anchor reputation, so the attacker's fleet sinks together instead of compounding. Numbers: 1,000 fake nodes at a  bond cost ,000, and one detection converts that stake to nothing before the first payout. Trust ends up like basalt, heavy to shift, while disposable aliases pop and fade without leaving a ripple on the ledger.
